chain.text: Mont Ventoux observatory runs a 60-cm reflector (2017) and a 20-cm outreach refractor, averaging 195 useful nights yearly (168 in 2024). Monthly data (~400 GB) transfers nightly to Marseille in 40 minutes. A March 2025 camera replacement cut read noise 30% but needs a full-night firmware update, not yet applied. Past incidents: a 2023 dome motor seizure bent a counterweight rod (fixed, limit switch added); a February 2025 timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry (now GPS-checked each session). Rules: no observing during outreach, raw frames compressed only after two years, software changes need a test night. A proposed Spanish collaboration awaits evaluation of its scheduling tool and network capacity.
